entries.4870f4df1fddef8c: A reportable segment that develops, manufactures, and sells information and communications systems and related products. In the fiscal year ended June 2026, net sales to external customers were ¥27,102 million (up 129.2% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥1,249 million (up 84.3%). It is carried out mainly by Iwatsu Electric Co., Ltd. and Nakayo Inc. The securities report gives as the reasons for the increase in net sales the addition of Nakayo's communications equipment business, which became a consolidated subsidiary from the fiscal year ended June 2026. It also cites the focus on cost reduction and on selling higher-margin products, and the transfer of part of the production of Iwatsu Electric's office business phones to Nakayo's factory. It also states that the domestic market is on a shrinking trend.
entries.53d7e259e1cf9e55: Cutting machines for individuals. In the fiscal year ended June 2026, a new low-priced product that is to become the main product was launched. The securities report states that the main North American market continued to be sluggish and the hobby craft market declined, resulting in lower revenue and a loss. No figure for this business alone is given.
entries.58de6ceb3614e2db: A business for condominiums, centered on demand for renewal of existing equipment and sold through direct sales. The securities report states that most contracts are lease contracts and that it will reliably follow up on properties due for renewal to secure stable long-term demand. In the fiscal year ended June 2026, in addition to renewals upon lease expiry, it also won many new condominium-for-sale projects. No amount is given for this business alone.
entries.60ebc9f5ac186c27: A reportable segment that develops, manufactures, and sells computer peripherals such as plotters and scanners, and provides maintenance services. It is carried out by Graphtec Corporation, Silhouette Japan Co., Ltd., and overseas sales companies. In the fiscal year ended June 2026, net sales to external customers were ¥12,671 million (down 6.1% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥562 million (up 21.6%). The securities report states that the commercial-use field saw higher sales and profit, helped by a recovery in sales in the European and U.S. markets, while the consumer field saw lower sales and a loss as weakness continued in its main North American market. The securities report states that, in response to weak consumer sales, an organizational restructuring was carried out to unify the management resources of the commercial and consumer fields in order to reduce expenses and improve the efficiency of business operations.
entries.730899013f4bc45d: An innovative power-saving and energy-saving system business that the securities report names as a future growth area. Revenue in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was approximately ¥1 billion, 136% of the previous year. The report states that recognition in the market has steadily spread, trial deployments have accumulated, and the move to formal orders can now be foreseen. For the coming fiscal year, the aim is cumulative revenue of ¥5 billion since the launch.
entries.8036694886101315: Cutting machines for individuals. In the fiscal year ended June 2026, a new low-priced product that is to become the main product was launched.
entries.835debb72bc91c85: A reportable segment that develops, manufactures and sells measuring instruments. In the fiscal year ended June 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥5,442 million (up 8.8% year on year) and segment profit was ¥786 million (down 4.8%). The securities report gives a delay in passing on increased procurement costs through prices as the reason for the decline in profit. In December 2025, the measurement business of Graphtec Corporation and the measurement division of Iwatsu Electric Co., Ltd. were split off to establish Graphtec Iwatsu Measurement Co., Ltd., consolidating the businesses.

entries.acee905c0d45dc6e: A reportable segment that conducts architectural design businesses centered on structural design and seismic diagnosis. It is carried out by Ai Sekkei Co., Ltd. and Tanabe Sekkei Co., Ltd. The securities report states that this resulted from steady orders for structural design in addition to winning a large seismic diagnosis order, and it expects lower profit in the following fiscal year because the large seismic diagnosis portion will no longer be present.
